meta.source: Systematic Strava-to-historical-calendar audit + user medal/photo evidence + official event records
meta.policy: Keep unresolved candidates here until the public record can be dated and placed accurately; medals alone do not prove a finish when contemporary event records show cancellation, deferral, virtual options, or automatic medal distribution.

knownEventsPendingDate.evidence: User owns the 2020 B3 Distance Series medal/holder. Contemporary reporting states that the 2020 Shamrock 5K was canceled, all registrations were deferred to 2021, and 2020 B3 registrants still received the Shamrock medal and holder. The medal therefore establishes 2020 B3 registration but not completion of all three races.
knownEventsPendingDate.reason: The strongest reconstruction spans multiple seasons. In 2019, Strava has a 4.59 km run on the exact March 10 Shamrock race date and an 18.00 km run on August 31; dated user photos and a Charles Street 12 2019 finisher lanyard independently verify the August 31 Charles Street 12. No Strava activity appears on the April 13, 2019 Sole of the City race date. For the deferred 2020 registration, Strava has an exact 5.02 km run on March 14, 2021, the final day of the official March 6-14 virtual Shamrock window for 2020 registrants, plus a 19.32 km (~12.0 mile) Denver run on September 5, 2021 near the Charles Street 12 race/virtual period. No run appears on the November 13, 2021 Sole of the City date and there is no obvious 10K-scale November 2021 substitute. A 10.04 km Baltimore run on May 30, 2020 remains a possible virtual Sole completion, but the permitted 2020 virtual window/individual result has not been recovered. Do not publish a completed B3 challenge until the Sole component and challenge completion are independently resolved.

knownEventsPendingDate.evidence: User owns an official 3D etched Mile High Challenge award. Strava contains qualifying Colfax 5K + Urban 10 Miler combinations in both 2024 and 2026.
knownEventsPendingDate.reason: The award itself does not show a year. Both 2024 and 2026 activity pairs match the organizer's 5K Saturday + Sunday race challenge format; do not assign the award to a specific year until medal design, registration record or other dated evidence resolves it.
